payload.posture: Read Numbers 11:16–30 as evidence about the Spirit, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states numbers 11:16–30 names God’s Spirit within a source unit where the Spirit rests and is put within; the wording centers attention on “I will take of the Spirit which is on you.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Spirit.
